title: WhatsApp and SMS through Lead Intel
hint: Connect the business's WhatsApp number so alerts, briefs, approvals and customer reminders can go out by WhatsApp, and replies can come back.
untestedNote: This connection was written from Lead Intel's published developer notes and has not been tried on a live account yet. Send a test message after connecting, and expect to adjust.
keyHint: From your Lead Intel account (Developers). Ziira checks it with Lead Intel, keeps it encrypted and never shows it again.
keyWriteOnly: Stored encrypted. You cannot see it again after saving.
numberHint: The number customers and staff will see messages come from.

mode.existing: I already have this number on Lead Intel

newHint: Lead Intel sets the number up with Meta. This can take a few minutes, and Meta may ask for a verification code that Lead Intel will tell you about.
existingHint: If the number is already on Lead Intel, Lead Intel sends a code by SMS to that number. Typing it here connects it, with its name and templates kept.
displayNameHint: Meta reviews this name. It cannot be changed here afterwards.
aboutHint: Up to 139 characters, shown in the WhatsApp profile.

notClaimable.number_not_connected: This number is not on Lead Intel. Connect it as a new number.
notClaimable.phone_number_already_connected: This number is already connected to another account.
notClaimable.other: This number cannot be connected this way.

codeSentTo: A code was sent to {{to}}. It expires in 10 minutes.
codeSentPlain: A code was sent by SMS to the number. It expires in 10 minutes.
startAgainAsk: Cancel this connection and start again?

progress.requested: Lead Intel is setting up the number. This page updates by itself.
progress.awaiting_code: Lead Intel is waiting for a verification code.
progress.connected: Connected. Waiting for Lead Intel to switch it on.

awaitingCode: Lead Intel needs a verification code for this number. Follow its instructions, then come back here.
cancelSetupAsk: Cancel the connection that is in progress?
failed: The connection did not work ({{code}}). {{message}} Check the number and try again.
connectedHint: Replies from people who write to this number come back to Ziira. Staff verify their own number in My account, Notifications, before they can approve by reply.
testHint: Within 24 hours of the person writing to this number any message may be sent; otherwise only an approved template can start a conversation.
testFailed: The message could not be sent.
disconnectAsk: Remove this number from Lead Intel? WhatsApp messages will go by SMS or email instead.
templatesHint: WhatsApp may start a conversation, or write after 24 hours of silence, only with a template Meta has approved. Until a template is approved, the message goes by SMS or email.
inboxHint: Messages people sent to this WhatsApp number. Replies from staff are handled as commands; everything is kept here.
inboxEmptyHint: When someone writes to the number, it appears here.
